question: For each school, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in the current academic term, specifically for the Political Science department (Course 17)? Additionally, for each academic year, show these statistics per school, and include a grand total for each school across all academic years in the format of (school name, null, statistics).   JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE

d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON WITH political_science_subjects AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC), department_units_stats AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > 0.2), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.area_stddev DESC) SELECT subq1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.coefficient_of_variation, subq2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, subq2.area_stddev, subq2.DLC_NAME FROM subq1 JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON subq1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS fodk ON sd.DLC_KEY = fodk.DLC_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN subq2 ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = subq2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY subq2.area_stddev DESC

AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_CODE, ed.FULL_NAME AS responsible_faculty_full_name, ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS responsible_faculty_email, rr.total_unique_subjects, rr.min_office_phone FROM RollupResults AS WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
    ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    ccs.TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17'
    AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
),
per_year AS (
  SELECT
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVG_UNITS,
    VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS VARIANCE_UNITS,
    STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS STDDEV_UNITS
  FROM base
  GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR
),
grand AS (
  SELECT
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVG_UNITS,
    VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS VARIANCE_UNITS,
    STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS STDDEV_UNITS
  FROM base
  GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME
)
SELECT
  SCHOOL_NAME,
  ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  AVG_UNITS,
  VARIANCE_UNITS,
  STDDEV_UNITS
FROM per_year
UNION ALL
SELECT
  SCHOOL_NAME,
  NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  AVG_UNITS,
  VARIANCE_UNITS,
  STDDEV_UNITS
FROM grand
ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH base_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
    ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    AVG(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units,
    VARIANCE(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_units,
    STDDEV(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_units
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccs.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
    AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'
  GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR
)
SELECT 
  SCHOOL_NAME,
  ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  AVG(avg_units) AS avg_units,
  SUM(var_units) AS var_units,
  SUM(stddev_units) AS stddev_units
FROM base_stats
GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH ROLLUP
HAVING NOT (AVG(avg_units) IS NULL AND SUM(var_units) IS NULL AND SUM(stddev_units) IS NULL)
ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR
